name: PDFBolt
description: Free, privacy-first, in-browser PDF suite powered by WebAssembly. Process, merge, split, compress, edit, convert, and protect PDF files locally on your device with zero server uploads.

capabilities.name: merge-pdf
capabilities.description: Merge multiple PDF files into a single unified document with custom page reordering.

capabilities.name: split-pdf
capabilities.description: Split a PDF into individual pages or extract custom page ranges.

capabilities.name: compress-pdf
capabilities.description: Compress and optimize PDF file sizes while preserving visual clarity.

capabilities.name: pdf-to-word
capabilities.description: Convert PDF documents to editable Microsoft Word (.docx) files.

capabilities.name: word-to-pdf
capabilities.description: Convert Microsoft Word (.docx) documents to PDF.

capabilities.name: edit-pdf
capabilities.description: Edit, annotate, draw, and add text or signatures to PDF documents.

capabilities.name: protect-pdf
capabilities.description: Encrypt PDF files with AES-128 / AES-256 passwords.

capabilities.name: unlock-pdf
capabilities.description: Remove password restrictions and decrypt protected PDFs.

capabilities.name: ocr-pdf
capabilities.description: Extract text from scanned PDFs and images using in-browser OCR.
